business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells LCDs, LCMs, TFTs and CTPs display products, with major operations in PRC manufacturing subsidiaries and Hong Kong trading/investment entities.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognised when display products are delivered and title passes; normal credit term is 30 to 150 days, with deposits of 30% to 100% from certain new customers.
business_notes: Product revenue: LCD HK$138.339m, LCM HK$367.961m, TFT HK$167.297m, CTP HK$263.010m.
Revenue fell 29.4% from HK$1,325.806m to HK$936.607m; management attributed the weaker result to cautious customers, competition, weak sentiment, high rates and geopolitical tension.
The Group held major associate interests in Nantong Jianghai and Suzhou QingYue; the Nantong Jianghai disposal was classified as held for sale at 31 March 2024.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow is positive in 2023 and 2024 but weak in 2022; 2024 operating cash flow includes working-capital release while revenue fell sharply. Display segment profit, not reported net profit including associates, is the relevant base for operating cash profit.
